answer: Run a random-audit of funding trails. Each epoch the network samples 5% of accounts and traces where their starting tokens came from, building a funding atlas. Accounts sharing one upstream wallet within 3 hops are merged into one identity for rewards. A farm of 1,000 puppets must fund each from separate, unrelated sources, costing fees and delay per hop. Honest agents cultivate one garden; at dawn each epoch the sample is redrawn, so no farm knows which puppet is next.
